material_source_control.scope: Apply only the rigid source-to-mechanical change to each recorded material donor, retaining its offsets. An authoring counterfactual. Nearest-body reassignment, tissue equilibration, and native promotion are excluded.

scope: Complete physical owner, accepted endpoint comparisons. Different initial approximations may alter nonlinear convergence. These captures do not qualify sustained performance, continuous anatomy, supported rest or cardiorespiratory cycles.

supported_intersections.scope: Existing signed tissue-on-skeleton forces projected onto the bed normal. Summed native quadrature weights can share a surface footprint. Distances compare the most compressed row with the nearest sampled maximum on this donor.

sampled_solid_penetration.scope: Exact registered cortical pairs in the accepted state. Solid-depth lower bounds use the wall triangle vertices, midpoints and centroid and closed, edge-oriented cortical meshes with absolute winding above one half. An unsampled penetration can be deeper.
